welcome_message:
Welcome to AgentOps Stacks — a Declarative Automation Bundle template for production-ready AI agents on Databricks.

This template generates a multi-agent scaffold with shared components, CI/CD wiring, and per-agent Databricks Apps — all driven by your choices.

input_project_name.description: Project name. Used as the bundle name, default catalog suffix, and root directory name.
input_project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Project name must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (min 3 chars).

input_initial_agent_name.description:
Name of the first agent. Additional agents can be added later.
input_initial_agent_name
input_initial_agent_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Agent name must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (min 3 chars).

input_cloud.description:
Cloud provider for the workspace. Determines CI/CD auth blocks.
input_cloud

input_cicd_platform.description:
CI/CD platform for promotion workflows.
input_cicd_platform

input_use_vector_search.description:
Include shared Vector Search component for unstructured data retrieval (RAG).
input_use_vector_search

input_has_chunked_table.description:
Do you already have a chunked Delta table to sync from? If no, the scaffold includes ingestion and preparation notebooks.
input_has_chunked_table

input_use_lakebase.description:
Include shared Lakebase (Postgres) component for agent memory (LangGraph checkpointer).
input_use_lakebase

input_memory_type.description:
Type of agent memory to configure with Lakebase.
input_memory_type

input_use_uc_functions.description:
Include Unity Catalog function tool references as a shared component.
input_use_uc_functions

input_uc_functions_exist.description:
Are the UC functions already defined in your catalog? If no, the scaffold includes definition stubs.
input_uc_functions_exist

input_eval_dataset_source.description:
How to create the evaluation dataset for this agent.
  synthetic — generate a golden dataset using an LLM simulator
  manual — scaffold a notebook with example rows to fill in manually
  production_traces — build from production traces filtered by tag
  existing — skip dataset creation (you already have one)
input_eval_dataset_source

success_message:
*** AgentOps Stacks project created in '{{.input_root_dir}}' ***

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.input_root_dir}}/src/agents/{{.input_initial_agent_name}}
  2. uv sync
  3. cp .env.example .env  — configure Databricks auth
  4. uv run python app/start_server.py  — run the agent locally
  5. databricks bundle deploy -t dev  — deploy to Databricks

Your agent: src/agents/{{.input_initial_agent_name}}/agent.py
Eval config: src/agents/{{.input_initial_agent_name}}/eval/gates.yml
